title: A Counterexample to the Tang Zhang Schatten Norm Conjecture and Sharp Positive Results
abstract: arXiv:2608.15558v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For $m\geq 2$, let $c_p(m)$ be the all-dimensional best constant in   $$ \left\|\sum_{k=1}^m A_k\right\|_p \leq c_p(m)\left\|\sum_{k=1}^m |A_k|\right\|_p. $$   Tang and Zhang conjectured an explicit formula for every finite $p>1$. We disprove the conjecture with two explicit real $2\times 2$ rank-one matrices at $p=3/2$. The comparison is certified by seven strict rational inequalities and, in particular, places the attained ratio above $207/200$, while the conjectured constant lies below $207/200$. On the positive side, we prove the conjectured sharp bound for every family of rank-at-most-one summands when $2\leq p<\infty$, and classify all equality cases. We also prove the corresponding endpoint statement for $p=\infty$. Finally, for arbitrary complex matrices, we establish the conjectured sharp constant in the case $m=2$, $p=4$.

translated_title: 对Tang-Zhang Schatten范数猜想的一个反例及尖锐正结果
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15558v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：对于 $m\geq 2$，设 $c_p(m)$ 为全维最佳常数，满足 $$ \left\|\sum_{k=1}^m A_k\right\|_p \leq c_p(m)\left\|\sum_{k=1}^m |A_k|\right\|_p. $$ Tang 和 Zhang 猜想了一个关于每个有限 $p>1$ 的显式公式。我们通过两个显式的实 $2\times 2$ 秩一矩阵在 $p=3/2$ 时反驳了这一猜想。该比较由七个严格有理不等式验证，并且特别地，将实际达到的比值置于 $207/200$ 之上，而猜想常数低于 $207/200$。在正面结果方面，我们证明了当 $2\leq p<\infty$ 时，对于所有秩至多为一的求和项族，猜想中的尖锐界成立，并分类了所有等号情形。我们还证明了 $p=\infty$ 时的相应端点结论。最后，对于任意复矩阵，我们在 $m=2, p=4$ 的情形下建立了猜想中的尖锐常数。
tldr: 本文通过显式反例否定了Tang-Zhang关于Schatten范数不等式的猜想，并在多种情形下证明了该猜想的尖锐正结果，包括秩一矩阵在$p\geq2$时的最佳常数及复矩阵在$m=2,p=4$时的最佳常数。
en_tdlr: This paper disproves the Tang-Zhang Schatten norm conjecture via explicit counterexamples and proves sharp positive results for rank-one summands when $p\geq2$ and for complex matrices in the case $m=2, p=4$.
